# `scene.unparent`: Clear parent

Moves an object to the top level of the scene.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(depth + siblings + subtree x path length)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: clear parent, alt p, detach

By default the object keeps its world position.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keep_world` | `boolean` | `true` | Keep the world position (default) instead of the local transform. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Object to move to the top level (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"target":"crate/lid"}
```

Result: `crate/lid (o:2) is now lid`
